verses.en: At the same time, saith the LORD, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.
verses.sm: Atua i aiga uma o Isaraelu, e fai foi i latou mo'u nuu.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD, The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.
verses.sm: o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, Na maua le alofa i le vao e le nuu na totoe i le pelu, o Isaraelu lava, ina ua ou alu atu e faanofo filemu ia te ia.

verses.en: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
verses.sm: Na faaali mai le ALII ia te au anamua, ua faapea mai, O le alofa e faavavau, ua ou alofa atu ai ia te 0e; o le mea lea ua ou faafualoaina ai loʻu alofa ia te oe.

verses.en: Again I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.
verses.sm: Le taupou o Isaraelu e, ou te toe ati ae ia te oe, ona atiina ae ai lea o oe; e te toe teuteu ia te oe i au topa, e te alu atu foi e siva faatasi ma i latou o e sisiva.

verses.en: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.
verses.sm: E te toe totò tovine i mauga o Samaria; e totò ai mea e tagata galue fanua, ma latou faatatagaina ai.

verses.en: For there shall be a day, that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion unto the LORD our God.
verses.sm: Auà e 00 i le aso e valaau ai tagata leoleo i le mauga o Efaraima, Ina tulai ia outou, seʻi tatou O ¿e i Siona i le ALII lo tatou Atua.

verses.en: For thus saith the LORD; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish ye, praise ye, and say, O LORD, save thy people, the remnant of Israel.
verses.sm: Aua o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o E toe manuia Isaraelu le ALII, Ia outou alalaga ma le olioli ia lakopo, ma ia outou alalaga, i le nuu e sili; ina faailoa atu ia, ia outou vivii atu, ma ia outou fai atu, Le ALII e, ia e faaola i lou nuu, o e ua totoe ia Isaraelu.

verses.en: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.
verses.sm: Faauta, ou te aumaia i latou ai le nuu i le itu i matu, ma ou faapotopoto ia te i latou ai tuluiga o le lalolagi; E faatasi foi ma i latou le tauaso ma le pipili, o le fafine ua to e faatasi ma le fafine o le a fanau; e toe foi mai iinei le faapotopotoga e toatele lava.

verses.en: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.
verses.sm: Latou te o mai ma le tagi, ou te taʻita‘iina foi i latou o latou aioi mai; ou te aumaia i latou i vaitafe i le ala saʻo, latou te le tausuai ai; aua o aʻu, o le tama aʻu o Isaraelu, o Efaraima foi o lau ulumatua ia.

verses.en: Hear the word of the LORD, O ye nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock.
verses.sm: Ina faalogologo mai ia i le afioga a le ALII, outou nuu e, ma ia outou taʻu atu ai i nuu tu matafaga e mamao, ia faapea atu, O le na faataapeapeina Isaraelu, na te faapotopotoina i latou, ma leoleo ia te i latou e pei o le leoleo mamoe i lona lafu.

verses.en: For the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he.
verses.sm: Aua wa laveaiina lakopo e le ALII, ua na faatauina foi o ia ai le lima o le ua sili lona malosi ia te ia.

verses.en: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.
verses.sm: E o mai foi i latou ma latou alalaga fiafia i le mea maualuga o Siona, latou te gasolo ane i mea lelei a le ALII, ia maua ai le saito, ma le uaina, ma le suauu, o tamai mamoe foi, ma tamai povi; o latou loto foi e pei o se faatoaga ua faasustina; e le toe vaivai lava i latou.

verses.en: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
verses.sm: Ona olioli ai lea o le taupou i le siva, o taulelea foi faatasi ma toeaina; ou te liua foi lo latou faanoanoa i le fiafia, ma ou faamatalaloto ia te i latou, ou te faafiafia ia te i latou sa tiga i latou.

verses.en: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: Ou te faamalilie manao o le au faitaulaga i mea lololo, e malie foi loʻu nuu i aʻu mea lelei, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD; A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, and bitter weeping; Rahel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they were not.
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, Ua lagona le leo i Rama, o le auega, o le tagi lotulotu lava; ua tagi Rasela ona o lana fanau, e le mafai foi ona faanaina o ia ona o lana fanau, aua ua leai i latou.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, Soia e te tagi, aua foi le tafe ifo o loimata i ou mata; aua o loo fetalai mai le ALII, e fai le taui o lau galuega, e toe foi mai lava i latou ai le nuu o e ita mai.

verses.en: And there is hope in thine end, saith the LORD, that thy children shall come again to their own border.
verses.sm: E fai foi le faamoemoe i lou iuga, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII. e toe foi mai lava lau fanau i lo latou laueleele.

verses.en: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus; Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke: turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou art the LORD my God.
verses.sm: Ua ou faalogo lava ia Efaraima ua faanoanoa o ia, ua faapea, Ua e aoai mai ia te au, ua aoaiina foi aʻu, e pei o le povi ua le aʻoaʻoina; ia e faaliliuina au, ona liliu ai lea o aʻu; aua o oe, le ALII e, o loʻu Atua oe.

verses.en: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.
verses.sm: Aua na faaliliuina aʻu, mulimuli ane, ona ou salamo ai lea; na aʻoaʻoina aʻu, mulimuli ane, ona ou popo ai lea i loʻu vae; na aʻu ma, ma aʻu masiasi, aua na aʻu tauave le luma na fai ina o taulealea o a'u.

verses.en: Is Ephraim my dear son? is he a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: O le atalii pele ea Efaraima ia te au? o le tama ea ia e fiafia i ai? aua talu ina Ou tautala ia te ia, ua ou matua manatunatu pea la te ia; o le mea lea ua tagi ai loʻu loto ia te ia; ou te matua alofa lava ia te ia, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, even the way which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.
verses.sm: Ina faatuina ia mo oe ni faailoga i le ala, ina faatu ia mo oe ni laau; ia faasaga lou loto i le ala tele, o le ala lava na e alu atu ai; ina foi mai ia, le taupou o Isaraelu e, ina foi mai ia i ou aai nei.

verses.en: How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the LORD hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.
verses.sm: E te fealualuai seia afea, oe na le tama fafine liliu ese? aua ua faia e le ALII le mea fou i le lalolagi, e siosioina le tane e le fafine.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity; The LORD bless thee, O habitation of justice, and mountain of holiness.
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII o ‘au, le Atua o Isaraelu, E toe faia e i latou lenei upu i le nuu o Iuta ma ona aai, pe a ou faafoisia mai lo latou tafeaga, Ia faamanuia le ALII ia te oe le fale e i ai le amiotonu, o le mauga paia.

verses.en: And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they that go forth with flocks.
verses.sm: E nonofo ai foi Iuta ma ona aai uma faatasi, o tagata galue fanua, ma E feoai ma lafu.

verses.en: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
verses.sm: Aua ua ou faamalie i le tagata ua lailoa, ua ou faamalilieina loto vaivai uma.

verses.en: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.
verses.sm: Ona ou ala ai lea, ma ou vaai, ua milie lava au i aʻu moe.

verses.en: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.
verses.sm: O loo fetalai mai le ALII, Faauta, e oo lava i ona aso ou te totoina ai le jua o tagata ma le fua o manu i le aiga o Isaraelu, ma le aiga o Iuta.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: E pei ona ou lamalama ia te i latou, ina ia ou liaiina, ma lepetia, ia ou soloia foi, ma faaumatia, ma faatigaina; e faapea foi ona ou leoleo ia te i latou, ia ou atiina ae, ma totoina, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children's teeth are set on edge.
verses.sm: E le toe fai mai i latou i ia ona po, Ua “ama e tama o vine moto, a e magiagia ‘ai nifo o le fanau.

verses.en: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.
verses.sm: A e taitasi le tagata ma oti ona o ana agasala; o tagata uma ua aai vine moto, e taitasi ma magiagia ai ona lava nifo.

verses.en: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:
verses.sm: O loo fetalai mai le ALII, Faauta, e oo i ona aso ou te osia ai le feagaiga fou ma le aiga o Isaraelu, ma le aiga o Iuta.

verses.en: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, saith the LORD:
verses.sm: E le pei o le feagaiga na ou osia ma o latou tama i le aso na ou tago ai i o latou lima e aumaia ai i latou mai le nuu o Aikupito; o laʻu feagaiga lea na latou solia, o aʻu foi na ou ‘ʻinoʻino ai ia te i latou, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII;

verses.en: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.sm: a o lenei le feagaiga ou te osia ma le aiga o Isaraelu, pe a mavae ia aso, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII, ou te tuuina laʻu tulafono i totonu ia te i latou, ma ou tusi ai i o latou loto; e fai foi aʻu mo latou Atua, o i latou for e fai moʻu nuu.

verses.en: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the LORD: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.
verses.sm: E le toe aʻoaʻo atu foi le tagata i le la te tuaoi, ma le tagata i lona uso, e faapea atu, Ia outou iloa le ALII; aua e iloa aʻu e i latou uma lava, o tagata nuu atoa ma alii, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII; aua ou te faamagalo i a latou amio leaga, ma ou le toe manatua a latou agasala.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD, which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The LORD of hosts is his name:
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, o le ua tuuina le la e fai ma malamalama i le ao, o tulafono foi i le masina ma fetu e fai ma malamalama i le po; o le e laolao ai le sami pe a u mai ona peau; o le ALII o “au, o lona suafa lava lea;

verses.en: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the LORD, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.
verses.sm: afai e mavae ia tulafono ai oʻu luma, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII, ona mavae ai lea o le fanau a Isaraelu, ia le toe fai ma nuu i oʻu IIIO luma e faavavau.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, Afai e mafai ona fuatia le lagi i luga, afai foi e mafai ona suesueina O faavae o le lalolagi i lalo, ona ou lafoaiina lea o le fanau uma a Isaraelu ona o mea uma ua latou faia, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the city shall be built to the LORD from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner.
verses.sm: Faauta, e oo i ona aso, o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII, e faatuina ai le aai mo le ALII, e afua mai i le “olo o Hananiali e oo atu i le faitotoa o le tulimanu.

verses.en: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.
verses.sm: E toe alu atu le maea e fua a‘i, e ui tonu atu i luga o le mauga o Karepa, e faataamilo atu foi i Koata.

verses.en: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy unto the LORD; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.
verses.sm: E faapaiaina foi mo le ALII le vanu uma ua i ai tino o tagata oti, ma le lefulefu, ma fanua uma, e oo i le alia o Ketarono, e 00 foi i le tulimanu o le faitotoa o solofanua i sasae; e le toe liaiina ia, e le toe soloia foi e 00 i le faavavau. Ua tuuina
